correctness.rationale: Inertia and zero diagonal yield trace zero; splitting positive/negative eigenvalue magnitudes and completing the two Cauchy–Schwarz squares gives exactly (r-s)^2/n^2, with equality iff two levels. The real Fourier constant-diagonal projection construction proves sharpness for all inertia signatures. The weighted complete-graph calculation reaches equality, and its rank-one shifted-matrix argument forces the unique positive diagonal scaling for n≥3. The displayed diagonal-plus-rank-one factor gives P-(I-P) exactly by projector algebra. Packaged verify.py passed 900 finite checks; no finite check substitutes for the proof.

Exact comparison to closest results is documented; residual priority risk remains.

The paper’s smoothed plus logarithmic loss has not been optimized here; no claim about that objective is made.

value.rationale: An exact factor-pattern obstruction and its equality classification are natural in fixed-support spectral preconditioner design. Weighted complete-graph congruences show that the best normalized diagonal-target loss approaches one with dimension, while a single explicit global rank-one correction reaches zero. This isolates a substantive support choice mechanism, not a mere numerical tolerance or terminology change; no downstream solver-rate theorem is asserted.
